limitations: One seed and one outer split per task; no statistical ranking.
Synthetic supplemental tasks are not private tasks.
Internal CV scores are not comparable across agents.
Ollama server memory is excluded from agent RSS.
Label separation is by input/evaluator contract, not an OS adversarial sandbox.
Some legacy binary runs optimized normal internally; external F1 always uses alert.
Holdouts are now consumed for diagnosis; future development needs new confirmation data.
